name: M2A3 - Bradley - IFV
description: M2A3 Infantry Fighting Vehicle: The M2A3 Infantry Fighting Vehicle is the latest improved model of the M2/M3 series of infantry fighting vehicles. It is the latest model of digital cavalry fighting vehicle of the US military. It is called the digital Bradley fighting vehicle. It has improved shooting control devices, target capture systems, navigation systems and situation warning capabilities, can more effectively adapt to the street fighting environment, and has strong information-based combat capabilities. In addition to serving in the United States, the vehicle is also equipped with US military troops stationed in Afghanistan, Iraq, South Korea and other places.
